annotation.summary_en: Two women in a train compartment discuss the logistics and finances of having lovers, while a male passenger listens from the upper bunk.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place inside a train sleeper compartment during the day. A woman in a black wide-brimmed hat and red ruffled dress struggles with a large striped bag, settling into the compartment with a heavily made-up passenger sporting curly hair and a tan cardigan. As they settle in, a mustached man is seen resting on the upper bunk, seemingly asleep. The conversation turns to the financial struggles of the woman in the hat. The curly-haired companion suggests that she needs a man—specifically a lover who can provide financial support, boasting that her own lover gives her $500 a month. When the woman in the hat expresses doubt that anyone would pay that much for her, the conversation devolves into a bizarre mathematical negotiation. They calculate various scenarios: two lovers at $250 each, five lovers at $100 each, and finally ten part-time lovers at $50 each. The woman in the hat worries about the scheduling logistics of five working men on weekends. The sketch ends with a punchline from the mustached man on the top bunk, who has been listening the whole time, asking them to wake him up once the price drops to 500 drams.
